introHtml: Clique sweaters and cardigans offer a modern, professional look that stands out in the corporate world. Made from soft, durable fabrics like the Summit ½ Zip in men's and ladies' cuts, these pieces are ideal for team uniforms, employee gifts, or promotional events. Decorate with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a polished finish that lasts. Choose Clique for consistent sizing and a fit your team will appreciate.
